name: wp-to-strapi
description: Migrate WordPress → Strapi v5 — core library, CLI, Nuxt UI, and Strapi plugin

scripts.build: npm run -w @paullefizelier/wp-to-strapi-core build && npm run -w @paullefizelier/wp-to-strapi-adapter build && npm run -w @paullefizelier/wp-to-strapi-cli build
scripts.typecheck: npm run -w @paullefizelier/wp-to-strapi-core typecheck && npm run -w @paullefizelier/wp-to-strapi-adapter typecheck && npm run -w @paullefizelier/wp-to-strapi-cli typecheck
